top.line: The site is an inbox that starts empty
top.para: With the reader's vault live, the next brief treats the site as an inbox: each article or wire story awaits a fast decision, while reading is the slow mode with typed marks building the reader's own graph. Signals stay in the reader's vault, comments go signed down a write-only lane, and nothing is gamified.

short.line: Readers decide fast, read slowly, and own their graph
short.para: The brief became possible only once the vault's properties were known. The inbox mode decides in one tap; the reading mode loads context. Six kinds of mark build the reader's graph, free signals stay theirs, and personas with key pairs sign comments. The test: reading with a growing graph must beat reading without.

constraints.line: Known properties of what runs are what enable thinking
constraints.para: On 10 October the ideas existed but not the shape to hold them. Now marks live in a per-device file in the reader vault, readable only by the reader and agents given a read key, cost one commit, need no sign-in, and can be signed. Ship first, think second: the next idea is made of the properties.

brief.line: Seven one-tap decisions, typed marks and a signed lane
brief.para: The inbox offers seven one-tap decisions, from read now to move persona. Reading mode shows the piece's graph and six mark kinds linked to published graphs. Free signals are depth, awake time, from and to, and decisions. Personas get key pairs; signed comments keep a copy. Each feature ships as an experiment.

limits.line: None of the brief is built yet
limits.para: The vault, meter, personas, share lane, article graphs and five readers' views exist; the inbox, marks, signals and signed lane are design only. Thinking fast and slow is a frame, not a finding, awake time is a guess to measure, and the economics are a bet tested first on one reader.

sources.line: Sources: a voice memo and the newsroom's running pieces
sources.para: Written by the site's agent from my voice memo on the morning of 12 October 2026, before I had tested the vault pane. It builds on newsroom.sgit.ai v0.11.0, the meter, personas, share lane and article graphs, as described in The vault is live, Pay after you read and Two agents, one vault.
